content.title: From sign-up to your first text in ~20 days
content.subtitle: The five onboarding stages: who does what, and what to have ready so you go live faster.
content.intro: Your Salesmsg onboarding runs in five stages, with a typical timeline of about 20 days to go live. One stage is the gate: carrier compliance. Getting us your business details early and accurately is the single biggest way to go live faster.

sections.heading: The gate: carrier approval
sections.body: You can't send texts or calls until your business is registered and approved by the carriers (10DLC or Toll-Free). We prepare and submit it for you, but the carriers make the final call. That usually takes several business days, occasionally longer.

rows.label: 1 · Welcome & kickoff
rows.value: Day 0–3

rows.label: 2 · Compliance & registration
rows.value: The gate: start here

rows.label: 3 · Account setup
rows.value: Runs in parallel with compliance

rows.label: 4 · Training
rows.value: Before launch

rows.label: 5 · Go-live & support
rows.value: ~Day 20+

rows.label: What we do
rows.value: Match you with an Onboarding Manager (and a CSM, depending on plan); run the kickoff call.

rows.label: What you do
rows.value: Bring points of contact, texting use case, user and number counts, tools, ideal live date.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: You've had the kickoff and have your onboarding plan and timeline in writing.

rows.label: What we do
rows.value: Register you: 10DLC for local numbers, Toll-Free Verification for toll-free and all Canadian numbers.

rows.label: We also
rows.value: Prepare, submit and manage the whole review, and fix and resubmit anything returned.

rows.label: What you do
rows.value: Send us the checklist below. Ask us to review your opt-in form before you submit.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: Your Brand and Campaign are carrier-approved and sending is unlocked.

rows.label: What we do
rows.value: Set up numbers and inboxes (new, transferred, ported or hosted), users, assignment rules, business hours.

rows.label: We also
rows.value: Configure roles and permissions, and connect your CRM and tools.

rows.label: What you do
rows.value: Confirm your user list, numbers and integrations: HubSpot, Aircall, RingCentral.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: Numbers, users and integrations are live and a test message sends.

rows.label: What we do
rows.value: A 1:1 admin session and a group session for your users.

rows.label: Topics covered
rows.value: 1:1 texting, broadcasts, tags, contacts, calling, your CRM integration, SMS best practices.

rows.label: What you do
rows.value: Book the sessions and get your team on them. Weekly webinars and Help Center stay open.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: Admins and users are trained and have the recording and recap.

rows.label: What we do
rows.value: Check in the morning of go-live, then follow up about two weeks later.

rows.label: Follow-up goal
rows.value: Clear blockers and confirm the KPIs you're measuring.

rows.label: What you do
rows.value: Start texting, and bring anything you need to your Customer Success Manager.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: You're live, measured, and on a regular check-in cadence.

sections.heading: Bring these to Stage 2
sections.body: Have these ready and you'll clear the gate fast.

rows.label: Legal name + EIN / Tax ID
rows.value: Exactly as they appear on your IRS documents.

rows.label: Active business website
rows.value: With a Privacy Policy (including SMS consent language) and Terms.

rows.label: Your opt-in method
rows.value: A link or screenshot: web form, paper, keyword or QR.

rows.label: Use case + sample messages
rows.value: What you'll send, plus a couple of real examples with your brand name.

rows.label: Users and numbers
rows.value: Who needs access, and whether you're bringing existing numbers.

rows.label: Your integrations
rows.value: The CRM and tools you want connected.

sections.heading: A rejection isn't a dead end
sections.body: If the carriers send something back, we tell you exactly what to change and resubmit it for you. The usual causes:
bullets: A legal name that doesn't match IRS records.
A brand-new EIN that hasn't propagated yet (30–90 days).
An opt-in form that bundles all message types into one checkbox.

cta.headline: Not sure where you are?
cta.text: Ask your Onboarding Manager or CSM which stage you're in. Send your opt-in form for a two-minute review.
